name: Jevify
tagline: Turns your scoring and checking bots into batch-sweep siblings for big sets
description: If you already run a fleet of bots that grade, rank or verify things, this one rebuilds each of them as a sibling that judges a whole batch in a single sweep. Long rubric chains collapse into one pass, so large sets stop crawling. It does not hand your bots new skills; it changes how their judgments get executed.
author: bartasurba
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
